_: Third real-trigger wiring — same MFSE_SpellTrigger script, different DELIVERY. A drinkable potion whose MGEF carries the trigger: OnEffectStart -> MFStoryEventDispatch.Fire(kw, drinker) -> SM ScriptEvent root starts MFSE_PotionTarget with Drinker=the player. Proves the magic-effect trigger script is delivery-agnostic (spell in magictrigger.json, potion here). Acquire with `player.additem XX000802 1` (XX = load order), then drink it from the inventory.
